card.name: Gaps before numbers and hyper- terms
card.fires_on: Small joining words, spaces or the start of 'hyper-' words just before a number, exponent or lab-abnormality term, mostly in oncology dosing and lab-threshold text.

modes.label: Blood count thresholds
modes.description: Gap right after a multiplication sign or 'to' before a lab count value like 10^9/L or 1.5.
modes.example: Withhold TEMODAR if platelet less than 50 × 10<< >>9 /L.

modes.label: Hyper- at word start
modes.description: The 'Hyper' or 'hyper' piece starting words like hyperuricemia or hyperchloremic.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage for<< Hyper>>uricemia Associated with Cancer Therapy

modes.label: Linking words in drug phrases
modes.description: Short words like with, of, in, receiving that link a drug to another drug or a test.
modes.example: INQOVI in Combination<< with>> Venetoclax for AML
